name: Anhalinine
summary: Anhalinine, also known as O-methylanhalamine or mescaline-CR, is a tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid found in Lophophora williamsii (peyote) and other cacti. It is structurally related to mescaline and is a cyclized phenethylamine analogue of mescaline. Anhalinine is also pharmacologically active, but is only a minor constituent of peyote and is unlikely to contribute to its effects.
